feeds.title: PowerliftingTechnique.com
feeds.description: Hello! My Name Is Avi Silverberg! I'm The Founder of the Powerlifting Technique. I've dedicated myself to the world of powerlifting for the past 15 years. I started this website because I was frustrated with the quality of content that existed on the internet around powerlifting, strength training, and gym topics broadly. The goal of this website is to provide the World's most helpful content when it comes to powerlifting and getting stronger.

feeds.title: Mark Lowe Lifts Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Mark Lowe. Although I became a regular gym go-er in my 40s and getting reasonably fit, I found I plateaued as I hit 50. I wasn't getting the results I was looking for and I was gaining the 'wrong' weight. At 51 I was introduced to barbell training and that transformed everything for me. I'm curating tips, tricks, general information, and learnings from my own experience for anyone looking to be fit at 50 plus.
